c127.title: At the natural history museum
c127.story: On Tuesday, Anna's little brother Taras visits the natural history museum with his class. First, they see a huge [[dinosaur]] and a [[dodo]], a bird that couldn't fly. In a glass case, they see a stone [[artifact]] and a [[fragment]] of mammoth bone. The guide says every living [[organism]] needs food, water and a home. In a warm tank, a [[chameleon]] slowly changes its color from green to brown. Taras finds a silk [[cocoon]] hanging on a small branch. Behind glass, [[termites|termite]] build a mud tower and follow a [[pheromone]] to find food. In the last hall, a model volcano shows red [[magma]] rising from deep underground. "When it comes out of the volcano, we call it [[lava]]," the guide explains. On the bus home, Taras says he wants to be a scientist.

c128.title: A weekend in Paris
c128.story: On their weekend in Paris, Anna and Mama find a small bistro. The waiter says, "Bonjour, [[monsieur]]," to an old man. Then he smiles at Mama: "Good afternoon, [[madame]]." "And for you, [[mademoiselle]]?" he asks Anna. Anna orders a [[madeleine]] and [[creme]] brulee, and Mama orders [[brie]]. At the next table, a German couple greets the waiter. "Hello, [[Herr]] Weber! Hello, [[Frau]] Weber!" he answers in German. "That's German for Mr. and Mrs.," Mama whispers. After lunch, Anna buys a red [[beret]] for twenty euros. On Sunday, they take a train to an old [[chateau]]. In the evening, they dress up [[a la]] old movie stars.

c129.title: Summer in Italy and Spain
c129.story: This summer, Max and his parents go on a [[cruise]]. Their [[liner]] is as big as a small town. In Venice, they take a [[gondola]] along a narrow [[canal]]. Then they drink coffee in a [[piazza]] and see a pink [[palace]]. In Spain, Max buys a small guitar as a [[souvenir]] for Anna. In the evening, his parents sit in a [[wine bar]]. Mom orders a glass of [[chardonnay]], and Dad asks for a [[pinot]]. "White or red?" the waiter asks. "Red, please, a [[pinot noir]]," Dad says. A man at the next table hears them speak Ukrainian. He is a [[compatriot]] from Kyiv, and he lives near their street!

c130.title: Rainy days in London
c130.story: Anna is taking a summer course in London. On the first day, it rains, and she gets very wet. Her teacher says, "In London, you need a [[trench coat]]." On Saturday, Anna buys a cheap [[poncho]] for rainy days. She also gets a soft [[fleece]] for cold mornings. She buys a long [[shawl]] for Mama and a wool [[cape]] for Grandma. She eats a [[scone]] with jam and buys [[toffee]] for Max. Later, she visits a small art museum. One old painting there once cost a hundred [[guineas|guinea]]. When Anna gets lost, a kind police officer helps her. She is wet, but happy.

c132.title: Letters in Athens
c132.story: Anna is in Athens with Max, but she can't read Greek signs. Max opens the [[beta]] of a new app for learning letters. The first letter is [[alpha]], and the third is [[gamma]]. Anna finds [[kappa]] and [[mu]] on a bus sign. On a café menu, she sees [[theta]] and [[phi]]. [[Chi|chi]] looks like an X, and [[sigma]] looks a bit like E. "And [[omega]] is the last one!" Max says. "I know [[pi]] from math class," Anna laughs. Later, they get lost in a garden [[labyrinth]]. Anna reads the Greek exit sign and finds the way out! On the plane home, they see a green river [[delta]] below.
